Frequency: 3 strength days/week + 1 optional conditioning/coordination day. Include daily knee/hip mobility as noted. Full gym assumed.

Global principles and guardrails
- Pain rule: 0–2/10 discomfort acceptable during, none after. No swelling increase the next day. If pain >3/10 or swelling lingers >24h, regress ROM or load.
- Range of motion: Avoid deep knee flexion under load. Work in pain-free ROM, gradually increasing as tolerated. Emphasize tempo control and isometrics to build tendon/meniscus tolerance.
- Bilateral before unilateral: Start with bilateral patterns and stable surfaces, then advance to split-stance/isometric → partial-ROM unilateral → supported single-leg.
- No plyometrics/jumping. Low-impact conditioning only (bike, sled push, elliptical).
- Tempo and pauses: Use tempo (e.g., 3–4s eccentrics) and mid-range pauses for control.
- Bracing and alignment: Track knee over 2nd/3rd toe, avoid valgus, maintain tripod foot contact.

Phase overview
- Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Rebuild foundation, knee tolerance, mid-range strength. Emphasis on isometrics, bilateral patterns, hinge dominance, controlled ROM, core/bracing.
- Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Progress load, introduce more unilateral and lateral patterns, deeper but still sub-symptom ROM, eccentric emphasis, trunk/hip rotary control.

Here’s a practical, strength-supportive nutrition plan to maintain bodyweight while optimizing recovery and knee health. Assumes 3 lifting days + 1 optional conditioning day. Adjust portions based on weekly scale trends and gym performance.

Core targets (daily)
- Calories: Maintenance. Start at bodyweight (lb) x 14–15 kcal or bodyweight (kg) x 30–33 kcal. Hold for 10–14 days and adjust by 100–150 kcal if weight drifts >0.3%/week.
- Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg (0.7–1.0 g/lb). Spread over 3–5 feedings (20–40 g each), 1 serving within 2 hours post-lift, and 30–40 g pre-sleep.
- Carbohydrate: 3–5 g/kg daily. Bias more carbs around training on lift days; a bit less on rest days to keep weekly calories even.
- Fat: 0.8–1.0 g/kg (0.35–0.45 g/lb). Fill remaining calories after setting protein/carbs. Include omega-3 rich sources 2–3x/week.
- Fiber: 25–40 g/day, mostly from whole foods.
- Hydration: 30–35 ml/kg/day water; add 500–750 ml around training. Include electrolytes if sweating heavily.

Nutrient timing
- Pre-lift (60–150 min): 30–60 g carbs + 20–35 g protein, low fat/fiber. Examples: greek yogurt + banana; turkey sandwich; rice cake + whey + fruit.
- Intra (if >75 min or high volume): 15–30 g carbs/hr (sports drink or diluted juice + pinch of salt).
- Post-lift (0–2 hr): 0.3 g/kg protein + 0.5–1.0 g/kg carbs. Aim for easy-to-digest carbs and lean protein. Add some sodium.
- Evening (especially on lower-body days): 30–40 g casein-rich protein (cottage cheese/Greek yogurt or casein shake) for overnight recovery.

Anti-inflammatory emphasis (knee health)
- Omega-3s: Fatty fish 2–3x/week or EPA/DHA 1–2 g/day if intake is low.
- Polyphenols: Berries/cherries, extra-virgin olive oil, herbs/spices (turmeric + black pepper, ginger).
- Color + plants: 5+ servings/day vegetables/fruit.
- Collagen/gelatin strategy: 10–15 g collagen or gelatin + 50–100 mg vitamin C 30–60 min before knee/leg sessions to potentially support connective tissue.

Sample macros by bodyweight (examples; adjust to maintenance)
- 75 kg (165 lb): ~2,400–2,600 kcal; protein 130–165 g; carbs 260–350 g; fat 65–85 g.
- 85 kg (187 lb): ~2,700–2,950 kcal; protein 140–185 g; carbs 300–400 g; fat 70–95 g.
- 95 kg (209 lb): ~3,000–3,250 kcal; protein 150–210 g; carbs 330–450 g; fat 75–105 g.

Weekly structure to maintain weight and fuel training
- Lift days (3x/week): Keep calories at maintenance with more carbs near training.
  - Split: Protein 30–40 g x 4 meals; Carbs 70–90 g at pre/post meals; Fats lower at pre/post, moderate at other meals.
- Rest/conditioning days (1–2x/week): Same calories but shift a bit more to protein/fats and slightly less carbs, unless a longer conditioning session is planned.
- Day before heavy lower session: Ensure full maintenance calories, 4–6 g/kg carbs over the day, hydrate well, and add a salty carb at dinner (e.g., rice + soy sauce).

Example day (lift day ~2,800 kcal, 180 g protein, 360 g carbs, 80 g fat)

Example day (rest day ~2,800 kcal, 180 g protein, 300 g carbs, 100 g fat)

- Lunch: Turkey/avocado wrap on whole-grain tortilla; side salad with olive oil.
- Snack: Apple + cheese stick + almonds (small handful).
- Dinner: Lean beef 6 oz, quinoa 1 cup cooked, mixed veg; olive oil drizzle.
- Pre-sleep: Cottage cheese 1 cup + cinnamon + walnuts (small handful).

Micros and supplements (optional, not medical advice)
- Vitamin D3: 1,000–2,000 IU/day if sun exposure is low; verify levels with a clinician.
- Omega-3: As above if fatty fish intake is low.

- General multivitamin/mineral if diet variety is limited.

- Weigh 3–4x/week upon waking; track 7-day rolling average.
- If average is up/down >0.3% bodyweight for two consecutive weeks: adjust by 100–150 kcal/day.

- If drinking, cap at 1–2 standard drinks max on non-training days; avoid within 2–3 hours post-lift to not blunt recovery.

This plan keeps calories at maintenance, supports strength gains, promotes soft-tissue health, and is easy to adjust week-to-week as training progresses.

- 5 min cooldown

- Goblet Box Squat (high box): 4x8, 3s ecc

- Cable Hip Abduction: 3x12/side

- Seated Calf Raise: 3x12–15
- Wall Sit Iso (limited angle): 3x30s
- Pallof Press: 3x10/side

- Progress loads modestly; maintain ROM unless fully symptom-free next day, then reduce box height by ~1–2 in.
- Add Adductor machine 3x12 on Lower A; Spanish Squat Iso 45–60s.

Mon – Lower A

- Box Squat 5x3 same ROM, slightly heavier
- Leg Press (partial) 4x6 heavier
- Ham Curl 3x8 heavier
- Spanish Squat Iso 4x30–40s
- Farmer Carry 3x30 m

Wed – Upper (as Wk1) + add Stir-the-Pot 3x8/dir

Fri – Lower B
- RDL 5x5
- Goblet Box Squat 4x6 heavier
- Step-up low box 4x6/side
- Lateral Band Walks 2x12/side
- Hip Thrust 4x8
- Wall Sit Iso 4x30–40s

Cardio A: 4 rounds; extend near-threshold to 75 s. Cardio B: sled 10 x 25 m + incline 15–18 min.

- Cardio A: 5 rounds; near-threshold 75–90 s; finisher 4 x 20 s; total 48–54 min.
- Cardio B: Sled 12 x 25 m; incline 18–20 min; optional ski-tuck oscillations 2 x 45–60 s.

Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Strength and unilateral emphasis with cardio volume peak
Goals: More unilateral/lateral, controlled deeper but still sub-symptom ROM; eccentric emphasis; cardio volume and density climb significantly.

Week 5
Mon – Lower A
- Trap Bar Deadlift 4x4 (RPE 7–8)
- Safety Bar Box Squat (slightly lower if tolerated): 5x3, 3s ecc, 1s pause
- Leg Press (progress ROM one notch): 3x8
- Nordic Curl (assisted) or GHR: 3x5–6 slow ecc
- Standing Calf Raise: 4x10, 2s top pause
- Spanish Squat Iso: 3x45–60s
- Suitcase Carry: 3x30 m/side

Tue – Cardio A (Threshold blocks)
- 2 x 12 min @ RPE 7–7.5 with 10 s cadence surge q2–3 min; 5 min Z2 between; total 44–52 min

Wed – Upper + rotary core
- Incline DB Press 4x6–8
- 1-Arm Cable Row 4x8/side
- Half-kneeling Landmine Press 3x8/side
- Pull-ups/Assisted 4x5–6
- Anti-rotation Press 3x10/side
- Copenhagen (longer lever) 3x20–30s/side
- SL Leg Press Iso at two angles 3x20s each

Thu – Cardio B (Over/under pyramid x2)
- 1U/1O, 2U/1O, 3U/1O, 2U/1O, 1U/1O; 3 min easy between; total 40–46 min
(U=Z3, O=low Z4; bike/SkiErg)

Fri – Lower B (unilateral + lateral)
- Bulgarian Split Squat to pad/shallow ROM: 3x6/side, 3s ecc, support as needed
- Step-downs low box (heel tap): 3x6/side
- Barbell Hip Thrust 4x6–8 heavy
- Cable Lateral Lunge Pattern (short ROM): 3x8/side
- Seated Calf Raise 4x12
- Lateral Wall Sit Iso with weight shifts: 3x40s total
- Dead Bug + Band 3x8/side
- Add Adductor Slideboard Iso 3x20s/side (end of session)

Week 6
- Strength: Progress loads 2.5–5%; slight ROM increase on split squat/step-downs only if totally symptom-free.
- Cardio A: 3 x 10 min @ same RPE (or +5–10 W); 4 min Z2 between; total 50–58 min.
- Cardio B: 2.5 pyramids (add first 3 steps of third); total 45–50 min.
- Lateral finisher: Lateral shift iso 3 x 35–40 s/side.

Week 7
Mon – Lower A
- Trap Bar Deadlift 5x3 heavier
- SSB Box Squat 6x2, crisp, paused
- Leg Press 4x6 heavier
- Nordic Eccentrics 4x3–4 (5s down)
- Calf Raise 4x10–12
- Spanish Squat Iso 4x30–45s

Wed – Upper + core (as prior) + Cable Chop/Lift 3x10/side
- SL Leg Press dynamic partial ROM 3x6–8/side, slow ecc

Fri – Lower B
- Bulgarian Split Squat 4x5/side slightly deeper if allowed
- Lateral Step-Over (low hurdle) 3x8/side
- Hip Thrust 5x5 heavy
- Adductor Machine 3x10
- Seated Calf Raise 4x12–15
- Wall Sit + Alt Heel Raise 3x40s

Cardio A: 2 x 15 min @ RPE 7.5 (low–mid Z4), 5 min between; total 50–56 min.
Cardio B: 3 full pyramids; 2 min easy between; total 50–56 min.

Week 8 (strength deload; cardio peak volume/density)

  - Ski Tuck Hold 3x30–45 s
  - Isometric Lateral Shift Holds 3x20 s/side
- Cardio A: 3 x 12 min @ RPE 7.5, 3 min easy between; last 2 min of each block +1–2% power; total 56–62 min.
- Cardio B: 3 full pyramids, 90 s easy between; total 52–58 min.
- Lateral finisher: 4 x 40 s/side.

Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Peak and taper to feel strong by Week 12
Goals: Peak strength expression, high aerobic power with controlled fatigue, skiing-specific isometric capacity; maintain earned ROM (do not chase deeper).

Week 9 (high intensity, moderate volume)
Mon – Lower A (strength)
- Trap Bar Deadlift 5x3 @ RPE 8
- SSB Box Squat 4x4, 3s ecc, 1s pause, RPE 7–8
- Leg Press (moderate ROM) 3x10
- Nordic/GHR 4x5
- Standing Calf Raise 4x12 (2s pause)
- Ski Tuck Iso 4x30–45s

Tue – Cardio A: 30/15s MAP
- 10 min warm-up with 3 x 15 s hard
- 3 blocks of 10 x (30 s hard RPE 8 / 15 s roll), 3–4 min Z2 between
- 6–8 min cooldown

Wed – Upper + core/rotary
- Bench Press 5x3
- Chest-supported Row 4x6–8
- Landmine Press 4x6/side
- Pull-up 4xAMRAP submax
- Pallof Press iso 3x20 s/side
- Copenhagen (long lever) 3x25–35 s
- SL Leg Press Dynamic (partial) 4x6/side

Thu – Cardio B: Ski endurance circuit
- 3 rounds:
  1) Elliptical Z3 4 min
  2) Sled push 2 x 20–25 m (RPE 7–8)
  3) Stair machine shallow steps 2 min (small steps, higher cadence)
  4) Bike 3 min (last 60–90 s low Z4)
- 2 min easy between rounds
- Finisher: Ski-tuck clusters 3 x (20 s hold + 10 s shift L + 10 s shift R + 10 s hold)

Fri – Lower B (capacity/lateral)
- Hip Thrust 5x5 heavy
- Split Squat to pad 4x6/side, 3s ecc
- Lateral Slideboard (short range) 3x10/side
- Step-downs 3x8/side
- Seated Calf Raise 4x12–15
- Lateral Shift Holds (light cable) 3x20 s/side

Week 10 (peak total work)
Mon – Lower A
- Trap Bar Deadlift 6x2, slightly heavier than Wk9
- SSB Box Squat 5x3 @ solid RPE 8
- Leg Press 4x8 heavier
- Quasi-Isometric Box Squat Hover 3x10–15 s just above box
- Ham Curl 3x8 slow ecc
- Calf Raise 4x10–12

Tue – Cardio A: 30/15s
- 3 blocks x 12 reps or hold 10 reps and add +10–15 W vs Week 9; same rests

Wed – Upper
- Similar to Week 9; add Farmer Carry Heavy 4x25–30 m

Thu – Cardio B: Ski endurance circuit (longer)
- 3 rounds:
  1) Elliptical 5 min
  2) Sled 2 x 20–25 m
  3) Stairs 3 min shallow
  4) Bike 3 min (last 90 s low Z4)
- Finisher: Ski-tuck clusters 3 x as in Week 9

Fri – Lower B
- Hip Thrust 5x4 heavy (last rep ~RPE 8)
- Bulgarian Split Squat to pad 3x6/side
- SL Leg Press (partial) 3x8/side, 3s ecc
- Lateral Lunge Pattern (short ROM) 3x8/side
- Wall Sit + Alt Heel Raise 3x45–60 s

Week 11 (peak intensity, trimmed volume – strength expression)
Mon – Lower A
- Trap Bar Deadlift 3x3 near-top working weight (no grinders)
- SSB Box Squat 4x2, crisp pauses
- Leg Press 3x12 smooth
- Nordic Eccentric 3x4–5
- Calf Raise 4x10–12
- Ski Tuck Iso 3x60 s (readiness target)

Tue – Cardio A
- 30/15s: 4 blocks x 10 reps OR 3 blocks x 12 at higher power if recovery is solid; otherwise 3 x 10

Wed – Upper (maintain, no PR chasing)
- Keep sets 3–4 each, RPE 6–7

Thu – Cardio B
- Circuit 3 rounds at Week 10 durations; reduce sled load slightly to keep RPE ≤7.5; keep finisher only if legs fresh

Fri – Lower B
- Hip Thrust 4x6 heavy + 1 back-off x12
- Split Squat to pad 3x6/side
- SL Leg Press (partial) 3x8/side
- Lateral Shift Holds 3x20–30 s/side

Week 12 (taper – feel sharp)
Mon – Lower A
- Trap Bar Deadlift 4x2 @ ~80–85% (snappy)
- SSB Box Squat 3x2 @ ~80%
- Ham Curl 2x8; Calf Raise 2x10
- Ski Tuck 2x45 s

Tue – Cardio A
- 30/15s: 2 blocks x 10 at Week 10 power; short, crisp

Wed – Upper (technique only)
- 2–3 sets each, RPE 6

Thu – Cardio B
- Circuit: 2 rounds only, no finisher; all Z3 smooth

Fri – Lower B
- Hip Thrust 3x3 @ ~80%
- Split Squat 2x5/side light–moderate
- Lateral Shift Holds 2x20 s/side
- 10–15 min easy bike

Nutrition for weight maintenance (daily targets)
- Calories: Start BW (lb) x 14–15 or BW (kg) x 30–33 kcal. Adjust by 100–150 kcal if 7-day average changes >0.3%/week.
- Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day in 3–5 feedings (20–40 g each); 30–40 g pre-sleep.
- Carbs: 3–5 g/kg/day; bias carbs around training; add 25–50 g on hardest cardio weeks (6–8) and peak weeks (9–11) while keeping weekly average at maintenance.
- Fat: 0.8–1.0 g/kg/day; include omega-3 sources 2–3x/week.
- Timing:
  - Pre-lift 60–150 min: 30–60 g carbs + 20–35 g protein, low fat/fiber.
  - Post-lift 0–2 h: ~0.3 g/kg protein + 0.5–1.0 g/kg carbs.
  - Hard cardio (≥40 min Z3–Z4 total): 20–40 g carbs pre; 15–30 g/hr during.
- Connective tissue support: 10–15 g collagen + 50–100 mg vitamin C 30–60 min before lower sessions (optional).
- Hydration: 30–35 ml/kg/day + 500–750 ml around training; add 300–500 mg sodium on heavy days.

Recovery and mobility plan
Daily micro (8–12 min)
- Breathing reset 1–2 min; patellar glides if taught; quad/glute sets 2 x 10 (3s squeeze)
- Mobility circuit x2: half-kneeling hip flexor 20–30 s/side; hamstring slider floss 8–10/side; ankle rocks 8–10/side; adductor rock-backs 8/side
- Calf/soleus stretch 30–40 s/side; tibialis raises 2 x 12–15

Pre-lift warm-up (10–12 min)
- 4–5 min easy bike; foam roll quads/adductors/glutes; activation circuit (ankle rocks, hip flexor stretch, mini-band walks, box squat to training height, dead bug/Pallof)

Post-session cooldown (5–10 min)
- 3–5 min easy bike; quad/ham/adductor/calf stretches 30–45 s; 1–2 min recovery breathing

Deep mobility/tissue sessions (2–3x/week, 15–25 min)
- Soft tissue (2–3 min each): quads, adductors, lateral quad sweep, glutes
- Hip openers: 90/90 switches 6–8/side; pigeon/figure-4 45–60 s/side; adductor rock-backs 8–10
- Ankle dorsiflexion mobilizations 2 x 10/side; calf/soleus stretch 30–40 s
- Hamstring neural glide 10/side
- Rotary core: Pallof holds 3 x 15–20 s/side
- Finish with 60–90 s relaxed breathing

Knee-specific therapeutic (2–4x/week)
- Spanish Squat Iso 2–4 x 30–60 s
- Wall Sit Iso (shallow–moderate angle) 2–4 x 30–60 s; add heel raises as tolerated
- Band TKE 2–3 x 15–20/side, 2s squeeze
- SL Leg Press Iso 2–3 x 20–30 s/side at 1–2 safe angles

Lateral control (2x/week, 8–12 min)
- Athletic stance weight shifts 2 x 30–45 s
- Lateral band/cable pulls 2–3 x 20–30 s/side
- Short-range lateral lunge mobility 5–6/side (unloaded)

Sleep and lifestyle
- Sleep 7.5–9 h; consistent schedule; manage stress with 5–10 min breathwork/walk.
- Hydration baseline as above; add sodium on hardest days.
- Optional modalities: brief cool pack 10–12 min if swelling; light compression sleeve for long days; heat before mobility on stiff days.

Readiness checks (2–3x/week)
- Morning knee pain/stiffness 0–10; swelling status
- Single-leg balance 30–45 s/side without valgus
- Step-downs from current box 6–8/side smooth
- Tuck capacity: 2–3 min total in 30–60 s bouts without symptom flare

Return-to-ski readiness (aim by Week 11)
- 3 x 60 s ski-tuck holds without pain/swelling
- Step-downs from 8–10 in box 3x8/side, perfect control
- Lateral shift holds with resistance 3 x 30 s/side, steady
- No next-day swelling after heavy lower sessions Weeks 10–11

Coaching notes
- Maintain tripod foot, knee tracks over 2nd–3rd toe, avoid valgus.
- Control eccentrics; stop any set when technique degrades or pain increases.
- Log ROM settings, loads, RPE, and next-day knee response to guide progression.

This integrated 12-week plan builds total-body strength, knee-friendly tolerance, aerobic power, and skiing-specific capacity, with cardio volume peaks in Weeks 4–8 and a clear peak/taper in Weeks 9–12 so he finishes strong, fresh, and confident.

Below is the complete 12-week program re-emitted with all adjustments integrated: strength (3 days/week), upgraded cardio (2 days/week with volume peaks in Weeks 4–8 and peak/taper in Weeks 9–12), nutrition for weight maintenance, and recovery/mobility. Constraints respected: no jumping, no deep knee flexion under load; progress ROM only if pain-free with no next-day swelling. Full gym assumed.

Global principles and guardrails
- Pain rule: ≤2/10 during; none after; no next-day swelling. If violated, reduce ROM, load, or volume immediately.
- ROM: Use boxes/stops to keep knee flexion above problematic depths. Increase ROM gradually only if totally symptom-free next day.
- Tempo/pauses: 3–4s eccentrics and mid-range pauses to build control/tolerance.
- Unilateral/lateral: Progress from bilateral and isometrics to partial-ROM unilateral and controlled lateral patterns (short range, no impact).
- Progression: If all sets at RPE ≤7 and pain ≤2/10, add 2.5–5% load or 1–2 reps next week.

Weekly schedule suggestion
- Mon: Lower A (strength)
- Tue: Cardio A
- Wed: Upper + core/knee
- Thu: Cardio B (or Sat)
- Fri: Lower B (strength + unilateral/lateral)
- Sat/Sun: Optional light mobility or move Cardio B here

Session template (strength days)
- Warm-up 10–12 min: 5 min bike Z1–2; foam roll quads/adductors/glutes; activation circuit x2 (hip flexor stretch, ankle rocks, mini-band lateral walks, bodyweight box squat to training height, dead bug/Pallof).
- Main lifts: 1–2 big patterns (trap bar DL/hinge; box squat or leg press).
- Assistance: quads (controlled ROM), posterior chain, calves, adductors, lateral hip.
- Knee isometrics/core: Spanish squat/wall sit/TKEs; anti-rotation.
- Cooldown 5–8 min easy cardio + light stretches.

Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Rebuild and control
Goals: Pain-free patterns, mid-range strength, isometrics, posterior-chain bias, set ROM baselines.

Week 1
Mon – Lower A
- Trap Bar Deadlift (high handles): 3x6, 3–4s ecc, RPE 6–7
- Box Squat (high box, thighs above parallel): 4x5, 3s ecc, 1s pause on box (no unloading)
- Reverse DB Lunge to high pad (short ROM, supported): 3x6/side
- Leg Press (partial ROM, stops): 3x8, slow ecc
- Seated Ham Curl: 3x10, 3s ecc
- Standing Calf Raise: 3x12
- Spanish Squat Iso: 3x30–45s
- Side Plank: 3x30s/side

Tue – Cardio A (Power ramps, 35–40 min)
- 8 min warm-up with 3 x 10 s high-cadence bursts
- Main: 3 rounds: 4 min upper Z3 + 1 min near-threshold (low Z4), 2 min easy between
- Finisher: 3 x 20 s hard, 100 s easy
- 5 min cooldown

Wed – Upper + core/knee
- Bench Press 4x5
- Chest-supported Row 4x8
- Half-kneeling Landmine Press 3x8/side
- Neutral Lat Pulldown 3x10
- Face Pull 3x12
- Copenhagen Plank (short lever) 3x20–30s/side
- Terminal Knee Extension (band) 3x15/side, 2s squeeze
- SL Leg Press Iso mid-range 3x20–30s/side

Thu – Cardio B (Sled + incline walk, 35–40 min)
- Sled push upright 8 x 20 m (RPE 7), 60–75 s walk-back
- Treadmill incline walk 12 min @ 6–8% Z3
- 5 min cooldown

Fri – Lower B
- Romanian Deadlift: 4x6
- Goblet Box Squat (high box): 4x8, 3s ecc
- Step-up to low box (shallow knee): 3x6/side, slow down
- Cable Hip Abduction: 3x12/side
- Glute Bridge (BB or band): 3x10, 2s top pause
- Seated Calf Raise: 3x12–15
- Wall Sit Iso (limited angle): 3x30s
- Pallof Press: 3x10/side

Week 2
- Progress loads modestly; maintain ROM unless fully symptom-free next day, then reduce box height by ~1–2 in.
- Add Adductor machine 3x12 on Lower A; Spanish Squat Iso 45–60s.
- Cardio A: 4 rounds total; Cardio B: sled 10 x 20 m + incline walk 15 min.

Week 3
Mon – Lower A
- Trap Bar Deadlift 5x3 (RPE 7–8)
- Box Squat 5x3 same ROM, slightly heavier
- Leg Press (partial) 4x6 heavier
- Ham Curl 3x8 heavier
- Spanish Squat Iso 4x30–40s
- Farmer Carry 3x30 m

Wed – Upper (as Wk1) + add Stir-the-Pot 3x8/dir

Fri – Lower B
- RDL 5x5
- Goblet Box Squat 4x6 heavier
- Step-up low box 4x6/side
- Lateral Band Walks 2x12/side
- Hip Thrust 4x8
- Wall Sit Iso 4x30–40s

Cardio A: 4 rounds; extend near-threshold to 75 s. Cardio B: sled 10 x 25 m + incline 15–18 min.

Week 4 (volume bump + deload strength)
- Strength: Reduce main lift volume 30–40% (keep intensity moderate). Test 1 notch lower box only if zero next-day symptoms so far.
- Cardio A: 5 rounds; near-threshold 75–90 s; finisher 4 x 20 s; total 48–54 min.
- Cardio B: Sled 12 x 25 m; incline 18–20 min; optional ski-tuck oscillations 2 x 45–60 s.

Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Strength and unilateral emphasis with cardio volume peak
Goals: More unilateral/lateral, controlled deeper but still sub-symptom ROM; eccentric emphasis; cardio volume and density climb significantly.

Week 5
Mon – Lower A
- Trap Bar Deadlift 4x4 (RPE 7–8)
- Safety Bar Box Squat (slightly lower if tolerated): 5x3, 3s ecc, 1s pause
- Leg Press (progress ROM one notch): 3x8
- Nordic Curl (assisted) or GHR: 3x5–6 slow ecc
- Standing Calf Raise: 4x10, 2s top pause
- Spanish Squat Iso: 3x45–60s
- Suitcase Carry: 3x30 m/side

Tue – Cardio A (Threshold blocks)
- 2 x 12 min @ RPE 7–7.5 with 10 s cadence surge q2–3 min; 5 min Z2 between; total 44–52 min

Wed – Upper + rotary core
- Incline DB Press 4x6–8
- 1-Arm Cable Row 4x8/side
- Half-kneeling Landmine Press 3x8/side
- Pull-ups/Assisted 4x5–6
- Anti-rotation Press 3x10/side
- Copenhagen (longer lever) 3x20–30s/side
- SL Leg Press Iso at two angles 3x20s each

Thu – Cardio B (Over/under pyramid x2)
- 1U/1O, 2U/1O, 3U/1O, 2U/1O, 1U/1O; 3 min easy between; total 40–46 min
(U=Z3, O=low Z4; bike/SkiErg)

Fri – Lower B (unilateral + lateral)
- Bulgarian Split Squat to pad/shallow ROM: 3x6/side, 3s ecc, support as needed
- Step-downs low box (heel tap): 3x6/side
- Barbell Hip Thrust 4x6–8 heavy
- Cable Lateral Lunge Pattern (short ROM): 3x8/side
- Seated Calf Raise 4x12
- Lateral Wall Sit Iso with weight shifts: 3x40s total
- Dead Bug + Band 3x8/side
- Add Adductor Slideboard Iso 3x20s/side (end of session)

Week 6
- Strength: Progress loads 2.5–5%; slight ROM increase on split squat/step-downs only if totally symptom-free.
- Cardio A: 3 x 10 min @ same RPE (or +5–10 W); 4 min Z2 between; total 50–58 min.
- Cardio B: 2.5 pyramids (add first 3 steps of third); total 45–50 min.
- Lateral finisher: Lateral shift iso 3 x 35–40 s/side.

Week 7
Mon – Lower A
- Trap Bar Deadlift 5x3 heavier
- SSB Box Squat 6x2, crisp, paused
- Leg Press 4x6 heavier
- Nordic Eccentrics 4x3–4 (5s down)
- Calf Raise 4x10–12
- Spanish Squat Iso 4x30–45s

Wed – Upper + core (as prior) + Cable Chop/Lift 3x10/side
- SL Leg Press dynamic partial ROM 3x6–8/side, slow ecc

Fri – Lower B
- Bulgarian Split Squat 4x5/side slightly deeper if allowed
- Lateral Step-Over (low hurdle) 3x8/side
- Hip Thrust 5x5 heavy
- Adductor Machine 3x10
- Seated Calf Raise 4x12–15
- Wall Sit + Alt Heel Raise 3x40s

Cardio A: 2 x 15 min @ RPE 7.5 (low–mid Z4), 5 min between; total 50–56 min.
Cardio B: 3 full pyramids; 2 min easy between; total 50–56 min.
Lateral finisher: 4 x 30–35 s/side.

Week 8 (strength deload; cardio peak volume/density)
- Strength: Reduce volume 30–40%, keep intensity moderate, technique focus. Add ski-specific isos:
  - Ski Tuck Hold 3x30–45 s
  - Isometric Lateral Shift Holds 3x20 s/side
- Cardio A: 3 x 12 min @ RPE 7.5, 3 min easy between; last 2 min of each block +1–2% power; total 56–62 min.
- Cardio B: 3 full pyramids, 90 s easy between; total 52–58 min.
- Lateral finisher: 4 x 40 s/side.

Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Peak and taper to feel strong by Week 12
Goals: Peak strength expression, high aerobic power with controlled fatigue, skiing-specific isometric capacity; maintain earned ROM (do not chase deeper).

Week 9 (high intensity, moderate volume)
Mon – Lower A (strength)
- Trap Bar Deadlift 5x3 @ RPE 8
- SSB Box Squat 4x4, 3s ecc, 1s pause, RPE 7–8
- Leg Press (moderate ROM) 3x10
- Nordic/GHR 4x5
- Standing Calf Raise 4x12 (2s pause)
- Ski Tuck Iso 4x30–45s

Tue – Cardio A: 30/15s MAP
- 10 min warm-up with 3 x 15 s hard
- 3 blocks of 10 x (30 s hard RPE 8 / 15 s roll), 3–4 min Z2 between
- 6–8 min cooldown

Wed – Upper + core/rotary
- Bench Press 5x3
- Chest-supported Row 4x6–8
- Landmine Press 4x6/side
- Pull-up 4xAMRAP submax
- Pallof Press iso 3x20 s/side
- Copenhagen (long lever) 3x25–35 s
- SL Leg Press Dynamic (partial) 4x6/side

Thu – Cardio B: Ski endurance circuit
- 3 rounds:
  1) Elliptical Z3 4 min
  2) Sled push 2 x 20–25 m (RPE 7–8)
  3) Stair machine shallow steps 2 min (small steps, higher cadence)
  4) Bike 3 min (last 60–90 s low Z4)
- 2 min easy between rounds
- Finisher: Ski-tuck clusters 3 x (20 s hold + 10 s shift L + 10 s shift R + 10 s hold)

Fri – Lower B (capacity/lateral)
- Hip Thrust 5x5 heavy
- Split Squat to pad 4x6/side, 3s ecc
- Lateral Slideboard (short range) 3x10/side
- Step-downs 3x8/side
- Seated Calf Raise 4x12–15
- Lateral Shift Holds (light cable) 3x20 s/side

Week 10 (peak total work)
Mon – Lower A
- Trap Bar Deadlift 6x2, slightly heavier than Wk9
- SSB Box Squat 5x3 @ solid RPE 8
- Leg Press 4x8 heavier
- Quasi-Isometric Box Squat Hover 3x10–15 s just above box
- Ham Curl 3x8 slow ecc
- Calf Raise 4x10–12

Tue – Cardio A: 30/15s
- 3 blocks x 12 reps or hold 10 reps and add +10–15 W vs Week 9; same rests

Wed – Upper
- Similar to Week 9; add Farmer Carry Heavy 4x25–30 m

Thu – Cardio B: Ski endurance circuit (longer)
- 3 rounds:
  1) Elliptical 5 min
  2) Sled 2 x 20–25 m
  3) Stairs 3 min shallow
  4) Bike 3 min (last 90 s low Z4)
- Finisher: Ski-tuck clusters 3 x as in Week 9

Fri – Lower B
- Hip Thrust 5x4 heavy (last rep ~RPE 8)
- Bulgarian Split Squat to pad 3x6/side
- SL Leg Press (partial) 3x8/side, 3s ecc
- Lateral Lunge Pattern (short ROM) 3x8/side
- Wall Sit + Alt Heel Raise 3x45–60 s

Week 11 (peak intensity, trimmed volume – strength expression)
Mon – Lower A
- Trap Bar Deadlift 3x3 near-top working weight (no grinders)
- SSB Box Squat 4x2, crisp pauses
- Leg Press 3x12 smooth
- Nordic Eccentric 3x4–5
- Calf Raise 4x10–12
- Ski Tuck Iso 3x60 s (readiness target)

Tue – Cardio A
- 30/15s: 4 blocks x 10 reps OR 3 blocks x 12 at higher power if recovery is solid; otherwise 3 x 10

Wed – Upper (maintain, no PR chasing)
- Keep sets 3–4 each, RPE 6–7

Thu – Cardio B
- Circuit 3 rounds at Week 10 durations; reduce sled load slightly to keep RPE ≤7.5; keep finisher only if legs fresh

Fri – Lower B
- Hip Thrust 4x6 heavy + 1 back-off x12
- Split Squat to pad 3x6/side
- SL Leg Press (partial) 3x8/side
- Lateral Shift Holds 3x20–30 s/side

Week 12 (taper – feel sharp)
Mon – Lower A
- Trap Bar Deadlift 4x2 @ ~80–85% (snappy)
- SSB Box Squat 3x2 @ ~80%
- Ham Curl 2x8; Calf Raise 2x10
- Ski Tuck 2x45 s

Tue – Cardio A
- 30/15s: 2 blocks x 10 at Week 10 power; short, crisp

Wed – Upper (technique only)
- 2–3 sets each, RPE 6

Thu – Cardio B
- Circuit: 2 rounds only, no finisher; all Z3 smooth

Fri – Lower B
- Hip Thrust 3x3 @ ~80%
- Split Squat 2x5/side light–moderate
- Lateral Shift Holds 2x20 s/side
- 10–15 min easy bike

Nutrition for weight maintenance (daily targets)
- Calories: Start BW (lb) x 14–15 or BW (kg) x 30–33 kcal. Adjust by 100–150 kcal if 7-day average changes >0.3%/week.
- Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day in 3–5 feedings (20–40 g each); 30–40 g pre-sleep.
- Carbs: 3–5 g/kg/day; bias carbs around training; add 25–50 g on hardest cardio weeks (6–8) and peak weeks (9–11) while keeping weekly average at maintenance.
- Fat: 0.8–1.0 g/kg/day; include omega-3 sources 2–3x/week.
- Timing:
  - Pre-lift 60–150 min: 30–60 g carbs + 20–35 g protein, low fat/fiber.
  - Post-lift 0–2 h: ~0.3 g/kg protein + 0.5–1.0 g/kg carbs.
  - Hard cardio (≥40 min Z3–Z4 total): 20–40 g carbs pre; 15–30 g/hr during.
- Connective tissue support: 10–15 g collagen + 50–100 mg vitamin C 30–60 min before lower sessions (optional).
- Hydration: 30–35 ml/kg/day + 500–750 ml around training; add 300–500 mg sodium on heavy days.

Recovery and mobility plan
Daily micro (8–12 min)
- Breathing reset 1–2 min; patellar glides if taught; quad/glute sets 2 x 10 (3s squeeze)
- Mobility circuit x2: half-kneeling hip flexor 20–30 s/side; hamstring slider floss 8–10/side; ankle rocks 8–10/side; adductor rock-backs 8/side
- Calf/soleus stretch 30–40 s/side; tibialis raises 2 x 12–15

Pre-lift warm-up (10–12 min)
- 4–5 min easy bike; foam roll quads/adductors/glutes; activation circuit (ankle rocks, hip flexor stretch, mini-band walks, box squat to training height, dead bug/Pallof)

Post-session cooldown (5–10 min)
- 3–5 min easy bike; quad/ham/adductor/calf stretches 30–45 s; 1–2 min recovery breathing

Deep mobility/tissue sessions (2–3x/week, 15–25 min)
- Soft tissue (2–3 min each): quads, adductors, lateral quad sweep, glutes
- Hip openers: 90/90 switches 6–8/side; pigeon/figure-4 45–60 s/side; adductor rock-backs 8–10
- Ankle dorsiflexion mobilizations 2 x 10/side; calf/soleus stretch 30–40 s
- Hamstring neural glide 10/side
- Rotary core: Pallof holds 3 x 15–20 s/side
- Finish with 60–90 s relaxed breathing

Knee-specific therapeutic (2–4x/week)
- Spanish Squat Iso 2–4 x 30–60 s
- Wall Sit Iso (shallow–moderate angle) 2–4 x 30–60 s; add heel raises as tolerated
- Band TKE 2–3 x 15–20/side, 2s squeeze
- SL Leg Press Iso 2–3 x 20–30 s/side at 1–2 safe angles

Lateral control (2x/week, 8–12 min)
- Athletic stance weight shifts 2 x 30–45 s
- Lateral band/cable pulls 2–3 x 20–30 s/side
- Short-range lateral lunge mobility 5–6/side (unloaded)

Sleep and lifestyle
- Sleep 7.5–9 h; consistent schedule; manage stress with 5–10 min breathwork/walk.
- Hydration baseline as above; add sodium on hardest days.
- Optional modalities: brief cool pack 10–12 min if swelling; light compression sleeve for long days; heat before mobility on stiff days.

Readiness checks (2–3x/week)
- Morning knee pain/stiffness 0–10; swelling status
- Single-leg balance 30–45 s/side without valgus
- Step-downs from current box 6–8/side smooth
- Tuck capacity: 2–3 min total in 30–60 s bouts without symptom flare

Return-to-ski readiness (aim by Week 11)
- 3 x 60 s ski-tuck holds without pain/swelling
- Step-downs from 8–10 in box 3x8/side, perfect control
- Lateral shift holds with resistance 3 x 30 s/side, steady
- No next-day swelling after heavy lower sessions Weeks 10–11

Coaching notes
- Maintain tripod foot, knee tracks over 2nd–3rd toe, avoid valgus.
- Control eccentrics; stop any set when technique degrades or pain increases.
- Log ROM settings, loads, RPE, and next-day knee response to guide progression.

This integrated 12-week plan builds total-body strength, knee-friendly tolerance, aerobic power, and skiing-specific capacity, with cardio volume peaks in Weeks 4–8 and a clear peak/taper in Weeks 9–12 so he finishes strong, fresh, and confident.
